metadata.description: Orchestrator for evidence-bound code review. Auto-detects intent and review state, runs gather → deep analyze (file:line findings) → review lenses → verdict report (PASS / PASS_WITH_ISSUES / FAIL) with confirmation gates and graph-guided patterns.

plugins.name: oh-my-codereview
plugins.description: Evidence-bound code review orchestrator. Gather the change surface, analyze into findings with severity and file:line evidence, deepen through review lenses, deliver a verdict report as Markdown, HTML, or a GitHub comment. Diff-first; whole-repo audit as an optional mode.
